name: Pulse Dots
description: A grid of fine dots that pulse one by one; the brightest carry a soft halo, and dots near the pointer light up.

props.name: color
props.description: Dot colour. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: glowColor
props.description: Halo around the brightest dots, and the tint of dots near the pointer.

props.name: speedMin
props.description: Slowest pulse, in radians per second. Each dot picks a rate between this and speedMax.

props.name: speedMax
props.description: Fastest pulse, in radians per second.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of a dot at its brightest, from 0 to 1. Resting dots sit at about a third of it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Brighten and tint the dots near the pointer. Off under reduced motion.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the field out toward the edges with a radial mask.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the field. Other div props are passed through.
